SYNTHETIC POH EN
Test document in English. This manual describes a fictional airplane used only for tests.

SECTION 1 — GENERAL
The stall speed of the airplane is 48 kt. The stall warning sounds before the stall. Fuel capacity is 40 gallons. The fuel pump feeds the engine.

Fuel system
The fuel tank holds 40 gallons of fuel. Check the fuel quantity before takeoff. The fuel pressure must be in the green arc.

Oil system
The oil pressure must read between 50 and 90 psi. The oil temperature must stay below the red line. Check the oil quantity before flight.

SECTION 2 — LIMITATIONS
The airplane is not approved for flight into known icing conditions. Icing can reduce lift. The center of gravity must remain within the approved envelope.

Flaps
The flaps extend to 30 degrees for landing. Use full flaps for a short field landing. The stall speed with flaps extended is lower.

Installed equipment
The airplane is equipped with a stall warning system. The installed radio is a VHF set. The installed transponder must be on during flight.

Mixture
Lean the mixture for cruise. The mixture control is on the panel. A rich mixture is used for takeoff.
